skills.description: Access GitHub through https://api.github.com — search repositories, read source code files, get repo metadata (stars, language, issues), list file trees, search code, download zips. Use this skill whenever the user mentions GitHub, a repo, open-source projects, or wants to find/download/inspect source code from GitHub, even if they never say the word "API". Especially valuable when github.com web pages are slow or unreachable (common on restricted networks) — the API endpoint is small, fast, and far more stable. Works with or without a personal access token: with one you get 5000 requests/hour; without it the skill automatically falls back to careful low-frequency mode (60 requests/hour). For the user, nothing to memorize — no API URLs, no parameters, no token storage: just state intent in plain language ("find X's source code", "how many stars does this repo have", "download this project") and the skill handles endpoints, query building, pagination, and token/quota management.
